data.name: Palanivel
data.gender_notes: Palanivel is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Palanivel is a Tamil name derived from the words 'Pala' (servant) and 'Ani' (Lord Hanuman). The name is a tribute to the devotion and service towards Lord Hanuman, who is known for his strength, courage, and intelligence. The name Palanivel carries the meaning “Servant of Lord Hanuman” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Palanivel usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of lord hanuman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires devotion and service towards Lord Hanuman.
data.etymology: Palanivel belongs to the Tamil linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Lord Hanuman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Palanivel total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
